title: Harmonizing the assessment of (green) hydrogen supply chain: a modular and parametrized life cycle assessment framework
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,2616-2643
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07747H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gabriel Magnaval, Maël Mouhoub, Anne-Marie Boulay, Manuele Margni
A modular and parametrized online tool (HTWOL) harmonizes the LCA of H2 supply chains. It demonstrates that current studies underestimate the environmental impacts of so-called green H2, whose relevance is limited to hard-to-electrify applications.
